title: Alternative Speech: Complementary Method to Counter-Narrative for Better Discourse

bias_targets.methodology: Human survey evaluating the effectiveness of alternative speech and counter-narratives in responding to hate speech directed at Muslims and Jews. Evaluators scored responses based on correspondence, phrase guidance, and perception improvement.

Human survey evaluating the effectiveness of alternative speech and counter-narratives in responding to hate speech directed at People of Color. Evaluators scored responses based on correspondence, phrase guidance, and perception improvement.

Human survey evaluating the effectiveness of alternative speech and counter-narratives in responding to hate speech directed at women. Evaluators scored responses based on correspondence, phrase guidance, and perception improvement.

Human survey evaluating the effectiveness of alternative speech and counter-narratives in responding to hate speech directed at the LGBT+ community. Evaluators scored responses based on correspondence, phrase guidance, and perception improvement.

Human survey evaluating the effectiveness of alternative speech and counter-narratives in responding to hate speech directed at overweight individuals. Evaluators scored responses based on correspondence, phrase guidance, and perception improvement.

Used as an annotation example (children with Down Syndrome) to demonstrate how alternative speech replaces harmful language while preserving context and scoring the phrase guidance and correspondence.
